description.value:
Requirements Declared Static

Cost 2 Bandwidth

Traits Paradise-Touched, divination, exploration

You spend 1 hour and 2 Bandwidth and ask one question about a place you have never been. Paradise answers. This effect can only be declared Static, never Signal, and its secret flat check is DC 8 rather than DC 5 — the answer is less reliable than an ordinary Static result, and you are told it exactly as though it were true either way. As always, you never learn the outcome of the check.

cinderfall.incomplete: Requirements: Declared Static. Cost: 2 Bandwidth. 1-hour ritual, secret DC 8 flat check (not the usual DC 5). A distinct DC number riding on the unbuildable Signal/Static mechanic, plus a real Bandwidth cost. The class's Signal/Static core mechanic has no rule-element analog anywhere in pf2e-source: `AdjustDegreeOfSuccess` evaluates in `beforePrepareData`, before the roll resolves, so it cannot hook a GM's own secret post-roll check or show the player a value other than what was actually computed (`pf2e-source/src/module/rules/rule-element/adjust-degree-of-success.ts`); self-inflicted reactive damage/resource cost keyed to the resolving effect's own degree of success has no rule-element home; and no `Reroll` rule-element key exists anywhere in the compendium (`pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/ancestry/human/level-1/courteous-comeback.json` ships `rules: []`). No `SpecialResource` rule element exists anywhere in the corpus for Bandwidth -- confirmed corpus-wide (`grep -rl "\"key\": \"SpecialResource\"" site/data/cards/` returns zero hits), and the class card itself (`site/data/cards/classes/classes.paradise-touched.json:49`) ships `system.rules: []`. Same absence class as Cultist Zeal/Ironsight Drift/Fleshmancer Vitae.
